text:
ellie: Quick q — when we surface SLO alert thresholds in Console, should per-tenant overrides be shown inline or behind an Edit modal? I worry about noise and accidental edits.
aj: my vote: show the effective threshold inline, but mark overrides with an icon and tooltip. editing stays modal.
devon: +1. Inline helps troubleshooting during incidents. We should avoid inline edit to prevent accidental churn.
sam: If we show inline, can we make it read-only unless you have write-perm? maybe greyed-out with a lock icon.
maria: Agree re perms. Also want to see notify-routing (pager / slack / email) mapped next to threshold. Ops oncall needs to know where it will fanout.
ellie: good—ops routing visibility is important. For UX, maybe a compact row: [effective threshold] [override badge] [notify targets]. Clicking override opens a modal with history + diff.
aj: sounds good. One implementation Q: our notify mapping API returns arrays and weightings. Example: 
```
{
  "notify_targets": [
    {"type":"pager", "team":"oncall-platform", "weight":100},
    {"type":"slack", "channel":"#slo-alerts", "weight":0}
  ]
}
```
We should collapse zero-weight targets in the UI but show them in modal.
devon: also surface fallback tiers — e.g. if primary is rate-limited, show fallback destination.
ops-bot: [incident-bot] reminder: any change to notify routing requires an audit entry and opt-in by security for tenant-scoped routes.
sam: UX question: do we show a per-tenant quiet window? Some tenants want quiet hours. That impacts alerting rules (suppress notifications but still record incidents).
ellie: we can model quiet windows as a 'snooze' flag with scope (tenant/global) and a skyline in UI. Need api changes.
maria: API proposal: add fields to SLO object: `overrides: [{scope: "tenant:acme", threshold: 0.9, notify_targets:[...], quiet_window: {start:"22:00", end:"06:00"}}]`
aj: sounds fine. We must be careful about query perf when there are many overrides. Cache effective rule per-route.
devon: agree; add a cache key version so rollouts can invalidate.
ellie: action items: aj -> mock inline row with lock/tooltip, devon -> perf impact doc + cache proposal, sam -> perms matrix, maria -> API draft for overrides + migration plan.
ellie: also flagging rollout UX: we should A/B test hide-vs-inline on a small tenant set (10 tenants) for 2 weeks, measure accidental edits and time-to-diagnose.
aj: will setup a feature flag + metric.
maria: I'll sync with security about audit requirements.
ellie: thanks all. Filing a tiny follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9876
sam: :thumbsup:
